newsitem.title: FRANCE: French transport group Geodis names new chairman.
newsitem.headline: French transport group Geodis names new chairman.

text.p: French multi-modal transport group Geodis said it has appointed Alain Poinssot as its new chairman.
He replaces Claude Gressier, whose mission -- "the creation, (partial) privatisation and restructuring of Geodis" -- was now completed, Geodis said in a statement.
Poinssot, 51, was previously managing director of customer ervices at French railway operator SNCF.
Between 1986 and 1995, he held the post of director Freight at SNCF.
Geodis' international air and ocean freight forwarding division, Geodis Overseas, tabled a 1996 turnover of three billion francs.

Geodis' global turnover last year, which also encompassed parcel delivery, road haulage and logistics, totalled 15.04 billion francs. - Reuters Air Cargo Service Tel+ 44 171 542 7706 Fax +5017 - www.racs.com
